goal: Rebind the four-source Midnight Season 2 candidate to the current 12.1 SimC runtime, SimC-generated talent graph and current S2 resource evidence without changing the active Manifest pointer.
userValue: Players will receive S2 talent and equipment recommendations whose runtime, graph and resource identities are checked against the current 12.1/S2 state, while the existing verified release remains available during revalidation.
nonGoals: Do not switch or overwrite Active Manifest generation 41 during this rebase.
Do not expand the frozen four-source S2 scope into a full-season Universe or scrape additional authorities.
Do not treat partial health, incomplete spell coverage, a return code of zero or a stale matrix as a successful current release.

currentTruth.candidateScope: Midnight S2 four-source resources, SimC runtime, SimC/TraitEdge talent graph and dependent Candidate evidence
currentTruth.retailScope: Active Manifest generation 41 remains the rollback-safe retail pointer until explicit later promotion authorization

mustChange: Update the remote SimC runtime to the current upstream midnight revision and record its immutable binary identity.
Run the dedicated SimC/TraitEdge talent recovery only after live PostgreSQL backup and fail-closed candidate validation.
Rebuild the S2 equipment Candidate dependency vector and rerun the fixed-runtime SimC matrix against the new runtime.
Record fresh health, Candidate, talent, gear and matrix evidence with explicit partial/blocked boundaries.
mustNotChange: The four logical S2 sources, official/community ownership boundary and Exact-first semantics.
Active Manifest generation 41, its rollback pointer and public release selection.
The existing Taro route contract or frontend behavior.
evidenceRequired: SimC upstream revision, remote runtime commit, binary hash, version probe and health bridge alignment.
Pre-write PostgreSQL backup plus SimC/TraitEdge LKG/candidate validation and recovery journal.
Fresh S2 Candidate/gear refresh result, matrix plan/report identity and no-pointer-change proof.
Targeted repository verification and a clear integration boundary for any remaining partial or blocked gate.

ownership.factOwner: The SimC runtime and PostgreSQL candidate stores own runtime, talent and equipment facts; the release pointer remains an explicit operator decision.

engineeringHealth.reason: The current production health is partial and the existing Active Manifest is retained while the SimC, talent and S2 dependency vector is revalidated.

acceptanceEvidence: The user explicitly approved execution of the freshness-rebase plan on 2026-08-25.
This operation is a backend/data Candidate rebase with no new frontend interaction or Active Manifest cutover.

decisionLog.decision: Execute a freshness rebase now, keep generation 41 active, and require fresh Candidate, talent, matrix and health evidence before any later pointer change.

Use the dedicated SimC/TraitEdge recovery with Blizzard and RaiderIO skipped; only after recovery, run a separate controlled official spell/media pass with RaiderIO skipped, and never use the broad service as a substitute for the recovery entrypoint.
